subject: Control Mapping Deep-Dive & Evidence Pull — IronGate RFP
body:
---Message 1 (original request)---
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@irongate.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: james.miller@irongate.com, security@irongate.com
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: IronGate RFP — SIG control mapping and evidence pull

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier this week. Attached is Annex A from our RFP which lists the SIG and SOC 2 sections we need substantiation for. We have two asks to start: a) a mapping that shows which Redwood controls map to the SIG sub-questions (including control owner and evidence filename), and b) a short bundle of artifacts we can review immediately for high-risk areas: KMS key rotation proof, deployment diagram showing tenant isolation, and SOC 2 scope doc.

Can you confirm:
- Target delivery date for an initial mapping (spreadsheet is fine)?
- Whether any artifacts are restricted and require an NDA or secure transfer link?

We prefer plaintext attachments or zipped PDFs. I attached Annex A for your reference.

Best,
Sarah Liu
Head of Security Operations
IronGate Systems

---Message 2 (internal response)---
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@irongate.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: IronGate RFP — SIG control mapping and evidence pull

Sarah —

Appreciate the Annex A. We can produce an initial SIG-to-control mapping by next Tuesday (2026-09-01) and a first-pass artifact bundle for the highest-risk items the same day. Plan:

- Today: Karthik will assemble the control crosswalk and identify artifact owners.
- Tomorrow: Marissa will pull the SOC 2 scope doc and the deployment diagram PDF.
- Monday: I’ll collate and review, then deliver the spreadsheet + artifacts via a secure Drive folder and provide a list of any items that are restricted.

Regarding transfer: we can share via a private Drive folder with view-only links; if you need encrypted delivery, let us know and we’ll provide a signed S3 presigned URL with IP restrictions. No NDA required for SOC 2 scope or generic diagrams, but key provenance extracts (KMS key material) are redacted; we can provide signed key rotation logs and KMS policy excerpts instead.

I’m copying Karthik and Marissa who will own the mapping and artifact pull.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

---Message 3 (internal, mapping draft + attachments)---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sarah.liu@irongate.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: IronGate RFP — SIG control mapping and evidence pull

Hi all —

Attached is the initial crosswalk (redwood_sig_mapping_v1.xlsx) covering SIG v2024 baseline questions and our SOC 2 control family mappings. Highlights:

- Many SIG sub-questions map to existing SOC 2 CC2/CC3 controls; column D indicates the control owner (infra, platform, or security).
- Column G lists recommended artifact names; where items are 'redacted', we provide proof-of-process (logs, policy screenshots) rather than raw keys.
- We flagged 7 sub-questions as high-risk for IronGate (encryption at-rest key proof, tenant network segmentation diagrams, and 3rd-party backup provider attestations).

Attachments included:
- redwood_sig_mapping_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet with crosswalk + owner + artifact name)
- kms_keyproof_snippet.txt (signed key rotation log snippet, redacted)
- deployment-isolation-diagram.pdf (high-level tenant isolation diagram)

Notes / asks:
1) For the backup/3rd-party attestations, we need to confirm whether you accept vendor SOC 2 attestations by link or require copies of the vendor report.
2) We redacted any secrets; if you need deeper key-level evidence we can route through an NDA and a secure artifact exchange.

Next steps: Marissa, can you package the SOC2 scope doc and the asset inventory export? I’ll stage everything in the secure Drive folder and share an access link.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Platform Security Practice (Redwood)

---Message 4 (external acknowledgement + scheduling)---
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@irongate.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, james.miller@irongate.com
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: IronGate RFP — SIG control mapping and evidence pull

Aditya / Karthik / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for redacting sensitive material appropriately. I was able to review the initial crosswalk and the KMS snippet; that addresses most of the immediate concerns. Two follow-ups:

- IronGate requires either the backup vendor SOC 2 report copy or a signed attestation letter from the vendor. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a vendor attestation or we should request the full report?
- Can we schedule a 30-minute technical deep-dive tomorrow (2026-08-31) at 10:00 AM PT to walk through the tenant isolation diagram and the flagged encryption controls? Please include whoever owns key rotation.

If you prefer, share the Drive link and I’ll upload a short redaction checklist for our legal team.

Regards,
Sarah Liu
Head of Security Operations
IronGate Systems

---End of thread---

Attachment stubs referenced: IRONGATE_RFP_Annex_A.pdf (from IronGate), redwood_sig_mapping_v1.xlsx (internal crosswalk), kms_keyproof_snippet.txt (redacted log), deployment-isolation-diagram.pdf (topology diagram).

Delivery notes: initial mapping created by Karthik (platform security) and artifact pulls by Marissa (assurance). Action items: confirm backup vendor attestation approach; schedule 2026-08-31 10:00 AM PT deep-dive call; prepare vendor attestation or report as requested.
